canc-05-c2.text: Nobel Assembly at Karolinska Institutet (2019). The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2019 to William G. Kaelin Jr, Sir Peter J. Ratcliffe, and Gregg L. Semenza. Karolinska Institutet.
canc-05-c2.quote: The Nobel Assembly at Karolinska Institutet has today decided to award the 2019 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine jointly to William G. Kaelin Jr, Sir Peter J. Ratcliffe and Gregg L. Semenza for their discoveries of how cells sense and adapt to oxygen availability.
canc-05-c2.claim: The 2019 Nobel Prize in Physiology went to Kaelin, Ratcliffe, and Semenza for working this out.

canc-09-c1.text: Nobel Assembly at Karolinska Institutet (2018). The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2018 to James P. Allison and Tasuku Honjo. Karolinska Institutet.
canc-09-c1.quote: decided to award the 2018 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine jointly to James P. Allison and Tasuku Honjo
canc-09-c1.claim: James Allison and Tasuku Honjo shared the 2018 Nobel Prize for discovering that T cells have built-in brakes, checkpoints, that tumors exploit, and that releasing those brakes unleashes anti-tumor immunity.
